groups.desc_placeholder: What is this group about? (visible to everyone who can reach this page)
groups.flash_invite_not_pending: That invitation is no longer pending.
groups.flash_invite_accepted: Invitation accepted — you are now a member.
groups.flash_request_not_pending: That request is no longer pending.
groups.title: Groups
groups.lead: The groups you own or belong to.
groups.posts_empty_can: No posts yet. Write the first one — it will be visible to the current members.
groups.about_desc_clear_hint: Leave blank to clear the description.
groups.private_hint: A private group (e.g. a family) is hidden from everyone else; only the people you add as members can see and use it. Clear the box to make the group public again.
groups.danger_delete_hint: Deleting the group removes it, its members, and any pending invitations. This cannot be undone.
groups.invite_note: They get an invitation on their Groups page to accept or decline.
groups.all_members_already: Every resident is already a member of this group.
groups.add_member_note: They are added to the group immediately (no invitation).
groups.post_why_body: You can see this post because you are a current member of the group.
groups.replies_empty: No replies yet. If you can see this post, you can reply to it.
groups.reply_audience_note: Replies have no own audience — they are visible under this post's single group-membership decision. You are replying only where the post itself is visible.
groups.new_visibility_note: Your post will be visible to the current members of this group only.
groups.events_empty_can: No events yet. Plan the first one — it will be visible to the current members.
groups.new_event_lead: Your event will be visible to the current members of this group only.
groups.translation_min_one: At least one of name or description is required.
groups.create_lede: A name for a community of residents (e.g. "Building 4", "Volunteers", "Bike owners"). You own the group — you can add and remove members from the group's detail page.
groups.create_desc_hint: Optional — a short note other residents will see.
groups.create_private_hint: A private group (e.g. a family) is hidden from everyone else — only people you add as members can see and use it. A public group (e.g. "Mushroom hunters") shows up as an option in other residents' pickers.
groups.edit_lede: You are editing your own post. Only you can edit it — the group membership decides who can see it, but only its author can change it. The group this post appears in is fixed; only the title, body, and language below are editable.
groups.edit_title_hint: A short headline (≤ 120 chars). Leave blank for a body-only post — the list will show your first line of the body instead.
groups.edit_language_hint: The language you're writing this post in. This is only a tag — it is not translated — and it keeps the text findable later and lets a reader add their own language version if they want.
groups.confirm_delete: Delete this group? This removes the group, its members, and its pending invitations, and cannot be undone.
